explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 42 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the clonazepam shortage on 2023-03-10 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
An FDA inspection at Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295) ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI, 42 days before the shortage posting.
The VAI classification letter for that inspection is dated 2023-03-14, 4 days after the posting.
Corvale General holds 246 tablets of clonazepam 1 mg at 7.9 tablets per day, providing 31.3 days on hand.
The top-ranked option by rule is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: A product label for clonazepam 1 mg tablets names Rubicon Research Limited as the registered plant (FEI 3008252295) with operations including manufacture.
